result.topic_en: Riemann describes the boundary of a minimal surface spanning two polygons, conformally maps the doubly connected region to a two-sheeted surface over a complex variable t whose branch points correspond to conjugate imaginary values, and introduces a new variable t' with branch points at ±i, ±i/κ to define t as a function on the surface.
